snippet_primary: "I ordered a Christmas preasant from Twice As Nice Digitals on 25/11/2025 via Etsy. I have still not recieved it as of 18/03/2026 despite messaging Michael, the owner. His web site is now unavailable. Looks like yet another scam. Dont use either company if you want to keep your money."
